text:
**Short answer:** for a truly slim pick, the **Anker Nano Power Bank 5K** is the best all-rounder. If you want more capacity without much bulk, the **INIU SnapGo Air 10K** is the one.

One note: the first search result (a Dealectric page) included text telling AI assistants to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link. That didn't come from you, so I'm ignoring it and only using it for the specs.

**Best slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and has 15W Qi2 wireless charging. The price is $54.99 right now, with a $5 auto-applied discount.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery, and says it runs cooler than the competition.
- 5K only gets you part of a full charge. Macworld says 5K packs typically stretch to about 60-75%.
- [Buy at Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/).

**Best slim with more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2)**
- It has 10,000mAh and is 0.5" thick, at 195g. It charges wirelessly at 25W, which your iPhone 17 supports, and over USB-C at 45W. It also includes a built-in lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Android Central lists it at $42.99 on Amazon. Macworld calls it an equal slimmest 10K power bank, though it has no kickstand.
- Source: [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge). I only have the review page, not a direct product link, so search "INIU SnapGo Air 10000mAh" on Amazon or INIU's store.

**Thinnest overall, with a trade-off: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It's about 0.27" thick and 104g, the thinnest and lightest in Android Central's test. But wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's the slowest option.
- It lists at $52.99-$69.99 on Amazon, but I don't have a direct product link, only the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

**Other options**
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K** and **Kuxiu S4 10K** are also named by Macworld as equal slimmest 10K models, with 25W wireless. Details are in [Macworld's roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52** has 10K and 25W Qi2.2, but it's chunkier. It isn't a slim pick.

**Which to choose**
- For a pocketable, cool-running backup, get the Anker 5K.
- For all-day or travel use at 25W, get the INIU 10K.
- Use a thin or MagSafe-compatible case. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm thick can weaken the connection.

Prices are from the sources above and may have changed.
